'''House Materasu''' is the current ruling House in [[Kandor]].

The High Seat of House Materasu is Queen [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]], who sits on the [[Throne of the Clouds]] in the [[Aesdaishar Palace]] in [[Chachin]]. It is known that she was already in line to the throne in {{ne|963}} when she was married to [[Brys Noramaga]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu}}

Regarding Prince Consort Brys, he adopted his wife's name after marriage, as she was of the greater House.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Brys Noramaga}} He could be considered as marrying into the House. It is unclear what Houses their children and descendents belong to, although the one example of their grandchildren we have in books, [[Kaisel Noramaga]], uses his grandfather's name.{{ref/book|13|42}} 

Queen Ethenielle has at least one brother and two sisters, who may or may not be part of House Materesu, and seven remaining children, including [[Antol]] and [[Jarene]]. Jarene married another Kandori lord whose name is not known.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jarene}}
